metadata.name: umanity
metadata.description: Umanity drops: USDC pots that unlock only after a delivery is proven, with refunds and a fixed 50/50 fee split

instructions.name: cancel_drop
docs: Calls a drop off. Its money can then only go back to backers and the fund.

instructions.name: close_backer
docs: After an unlock nobody can be owed a refund, so the record's rent goes
back to whoever paid it. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: create_drop
docs: `meta_hash` is the sha256 of the drop's public description (place,
shopping list, prices), so the page can prove it was never edited.

instructions.name: fund_drop
docs: Moves money the drops fund holds into a pot.

instructions.name: give
docs: Gives `amount` USDC from the giver's account. `backer` is who gets a
refund if the drop doesn't happen: usually the giver, or the real
person behind a relayed gift (an agent paying over x402, a gift that
arrived from another chain). `payer` covers the record's rent, so a
sponsor can pay it for people with no SOL.

instructions.name: give_all
docs: Gives everything in the source account above `keep`, up to what the
pot has room for. Built for execute-on-arrival flows (Aurora Intents
Connect): the intermediary that received a cross-chain payout calls it
without knowing the exact amount. The backer record must already be
open (`open_backer`), so the intermediary needs no SOL.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time setup, signed by the program's upgrade authority so nobody
can claim a fresh deployment first.

instructions.name: lock_release_authority
docs: One-way: after this, not even the admin can change who unlocks pots.

instructions.name: open_backer
docs: Opens an empty backer record so a later `give_all` needs no rent.

instructions.name: post_proof
docs: The field team posts the hash of the proof bundle (video, photos,
receipts). Gifts close and the review window starts. Posting again
replaces the hash and restarts the window.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Sends a backer everything they gave, once refunds are open. Anyone can
call it, and the money can only go to the backer, so Umanity can send
every refund without anyone having to ask.

instructions.name: return_to_fund
docs: Once refunds are open, returns everything in the pot that isn't owed
to a backer (fund money, plain transfers) to the drops fund.

instructions.name: set_release_authority
docs: Hands unlock rights to a new key (later: an address NEAR's Chain
Signatures controls). Refused once `lock_release_authority` ran.

instructions.name: split_fees
docs: Splits whatever USDC is in the fee inbox: half to the drops fund,
half to ops. Anyone can call it.

instructions.name: sweep_meteora_fees
docs: Claims $UMANITY trading fees from Meteora into the fee inbox, then
splits them. Our `fees` address is the pool config's fee claimer, so
this program is the only thing that can claim them. Anyone can call it.

accounts.name: fees_base
docs: Receives any base-token fees (none when the pool collects fees in USDC).

instructions.name: unlock
docs: Pays the whole pot to the drop's payee. `proof_hash` names the proof
this unlock was approved for; if the proof has been replaced since,
the unlock fails, so an approval can never pay out on other proof.

errors.name: DropClosed
errors.msg: This drop is no longer taking gifts

errors.name: InReview
errors.msg: The review window is still open

errors.name: RefundsNotOpen
errors.msg: Refunds are not open for this drop

errors.name: AlreadyFinal
errors.msg: This drop is already unlocked or cancelled

errors.name: ProofChanged
errors.msg: The drop's proof has changed since this unlock was approved

fields.name: max_pot
docs: Most a single pot can hold (USDC base units).

fields.name: review_secs
docs: Seconds between posting proof and the earliest unlock.

fields.name: fees_split
docs: Lifetime totals, so the Money page can check them against the chain.

fields.name: state
docs: 0 open, 1 proven, 2 unlocked, 3 cancelled

fields.name: given
docs: Recorded gifts (refundable to their backers).
